description: This file defines an interface for WebSocket configuration, specifying methods for retrieving configuration parameters such as buffer sizes, throttling factors, and rendering configuration into a Config object. It also includes an enum for known configuration keys with default values.

classes.name: WebsocketConfig
classes.description: Interface providing configuration settings for WebSocket endpoints, including buffer sizes, throttling factors, and related configuration rendering methods.

methods.name: getSubscriberBackpressureQueueSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum queue size of inflight commands per WebSocket client.

methods.name: getPublisherBackpressureBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum buffer size for outstanding command responses and events per WebSocket client.

methods.name: getThrottlingRejectionFactor
methods.description: Returns the factor of maximum throughput at which rejections are sent.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates a Config object representing the current configuration settings, including fallbacks.
